description: There are over 2,500 types of moths in the UK, but the ones most commonly associated with fabric damage are the Common Webbing Clothes Moth (Tineola bisselliella), Case-Bearing Moth (Tinea pellionella) AKA Carpet moth, and Pale-Backed Moth (Monopis crocicapitella). Their larvae may be responsible for damage to clothing, carpets, and textiles. Looking for a way to track moth activity in your home? MothOut Pheromone Clothes Moth Traps are a safe, discreet, and effective way to detect the presence and the scale of clothes moths infestation and helping you identify the species. The included eBook will provide you with DIY actions that may be necessary to eliminate moths and protect your wardrobe, fabrics, and home. Why choose MothOut Clothes Moth Monitoring Traps? Early Detection & Monitoring – Designed to help identify the presence of clothes moths in wardrobes, drawers, or storage areas. Non-Toxic & Safe – Free from harmful chemicals, these monitoring traps are safe for homes, including those with children and pets. Pheromone-Infused Glue Traps – Attracts male moths to indicate their presence and assess the potential size of an infestation. Includes Dried Lavender – Adds a natural fresh scent to wardrobes and drawers. Long-Lasting & Effective – Sealed foil packaging preserves the effectiveness of the traps for reliable service. Easy to Use – Simple peel, fold, and place setup for effortless moth action. Great Value – A complete monitoring solution and expert moth elimination and prevention strategies in an easy-to-read eBook in one pack, with no additional tools required. Early identification of moth activity increases the opportunity to address the issue proactively, reducing the need for chemical interventions and preventing the infestation from escalating. This helps save time, money, and protect your belongings. MothOut Pheromone traps are designed to help you confirm moth activity and highlight the most active areas in wardrobes, drawers, storage boxes, rugs and carpets. Captures on the sticky surface provide a clear indication that adult moths are present, helping you decide where to focus cleaning, inspection, and preventative actions. Where to place traps for best results (quick guide) Wardrobes / closets: hang on the wardrobe rail, or place on a shelf near stored wool, cashmere, silk or seasonal clothing. Drawers / storage boxes: place flat inside drawers or on top of storage boxes (away from direct contact with garments). Carpets / rugs: place flat near carpet edges, under furniture, behind curtains, or close to skirting boards where moths may travel. Spacing: for clearer monitoring results, use one trap per room and keep traps at least 3 metres apart. Glow pads (optional support in low light) The included glowing pads are designed to help visibility in darker areas such as wardrobes, under beds, and storage spaces. For best results, “charge” them near natural light or room lighting during the day. You can also try using traps with and without the glow pads to see what works best in your home. Lavender sachet (freshness for storage spaces) The included dried lavender sachet adds a pleasant, clean fragrance to wardrobes and drawers. For best monitoring performance, place the sachet in the same area but not directly next to the trap, so the pheromone scent remains the main attractant. Keep at least 3 meters distance. Compatibility notes (important) These pheromones target the most common fabric-associated moths. If you are seeing moths but catching none, it may indicate: the moth species is not attracted to these pheromones, the trap is too close to strong airflow (open windows / vents), or the infestation source is in an adjacent area (loft insulation, under furniture, behind skirting, etc.). If you can, send us a clear photo of the moths you are seeing/catching and we will help you identify the species and adjust your setup. Simple DIY actions that support monitoring Wash washable items at the highest safe temperature for the fabric (preferable above 55oC, check labels). Vacuum carpet edges, under furniture, and wardrobe floors; dispose of vacuum contents promptly. Reduce clutter in storage areas so moth hotspots are easier to identify. Keep vulnerable textiles (wool, cashmere, silk, felt, feathers) clean and stored in sealed bags/boxes. Safety information Keep out of reach of children and pets. The sticky surface uses a strong adhesive and may stick to skin or fabrics if touched. Contains dried lavender which may cause an allergic reaction in individuals sensitive to lavender.
